body: Rework substrate habitat area calculation so it depends on the actual substrate amount, not stored constants. Right now `SubstrateSurface` only checks whether `substrate_layers` is empty and otherwise returns the full footprint (`crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs:205-209`), while `SubstrateDeep` just sums the serialized `layer.colonizable_area_cm2` values (`crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs:220-225`). Those per-layer areas are precomputed as `footprint * colonizable_area_factor` without any depth term in scenario materialization (`crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:748-754`), and the default layer hardcodes `100.0 cm²` (`crates/tank_core/src/types/substrate.rs:24-33`). The result is that larger tanks, deeper layers, or zero-depth layers can report the wrong substrate habitat area even after `refresh_habitat_registry()`.
